title: Returning Birds
subtitle: Welcome back to your warm nest. Welcome back to a good ending.

trails.title: Trail ① The Song of A Puppy
trails.description: A lively song praising the courage of a puppy.

content.text:
I once looked down at a brave young dog,
It was gallant, the most courageous of all.
It wears a hat in piebald, and has eyes of emerald.
The first-magnitude stars sprinkle on its spine. Its tail was as green as the moss.

It was once asleep, once hungry, once afraid, once in tears,
once an umbrella, once a tree,
once a jumping coat rack and a ship
Oh, but then, but then --
It's again the brave young dog. Loyal and gutsy, it walks among the hearts of gold.

items.text: Returning Birds

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: How do you feel?

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Getting used to the light?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Hmm ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The wind feels ... so good ...

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Haha, this is just an appetizer. I'll be gentle since you are just "discharged."

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Are they alright?

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Good as new.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: They stayed up all night, just to save you.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Haha, I guess you are the only one who has slept tight.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Haha ...

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Madam Z, Druvis, Sonetto ...

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: From the bill, and the protesting, to countless debates, planning and ...

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Everyone is holding their umbrellas for you, Vertin.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: The "Storm"...

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: It will pass, one day.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Thank you. Thank you all.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Yes. Everything is going to be alright.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Enough flying. Time to head back.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: What are we doing next?

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Hmm ... no idea. Meet your friends first.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Fight with your comrade in arms, fear no danger ahead.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Grab tight, I'm going to speed up.
The wind flows through them like waves.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Charge! The great Red 38!

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Long live Su-01ве!

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: How are you feeling? Better now?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: *coughs* ... It's ... it's killing me …

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Here's water! Captain, sip, please. Don't put too much pressure on your esophagus.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: *sighs* This APPLe told you not to swallow leba in haste ...

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: *drinks water*

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Ah ... *coughing* …

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: I'm ... I'm alive ... Ah ...

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Oooh, I thought I wouldn't be able to see the sun tomorrow or see Vertin discharged!
You will.

branch.text: Is it because they have been apart for too long?
Or is this an illusion generated by their longingness?
They turn around in slow motion, straining their eyes.

items.text: Why are the leba bread here?

branch.text: Mixed feelings turn into tears running out of her eyes. Is it out of shock, or ecstasy?
So many struggling days and nights.
This is the finish line of desperation. Ahead of them, hopes await.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Vertin!

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: Vertin!!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Vertin!!!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Whoa ... *sobbing* ...

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: Are you feeling okay? There was a lot of equipment connected to you ...

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: Do you feel any discomfort?

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Do you need any nutritional supplements, Ms. Vertin? We have a lot of healthy, fresh salads here ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Where did you come back from? What are all these white pigeons doing after you?

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: You seem to have gained weight ... No no, lost weight? Um, no ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I'm fine. Fit as a fiddle.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Just a bit of headache, nothing else.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: It's good to see you again.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Thank you for being here ... being around me.
Regulus wipes her face on the coat in front of her.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: ... Of course!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Of course we ... we're waiting for you!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: You're the only ... friend we have in this world!
All the waiting has been worthwhile.
In the meantime, footsteps come from a distance.
Footsteps of well-trained, strong soldiers.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Welcome back, Vertin.
A figure in a white robe emerges in the woods.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: We have good news to share.
Next to her, stand Sonetto, Madam Z, and some unfamiliar faces.
The moment their eyes meet in the air, Sonetto opens her mouth—but she eventually doesn't speak a word.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: ... This is good. This is great.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: May I ask what good news?

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: The passage of the bill—Storm Reformation: Manpower and Discipline.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Once it's approved by the Pax Security Council, it will become law.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Your friends and you will enjoy more autonomy, and a life with even fewer restrictions.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: You will also have a more respectable status in the Foundation.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Ms. Z will fill you in with more details.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Thank you for telling me this.
Lilya, who has been quiet by their side the whole time, suddenly speaks up.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: What about the treatment?

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Treatment?

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Didn't it finish just now?

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: This treatment has an investigative purpose, and the Timekeeper has passed the examination as a safe, low-risk individual. As Ms. Z has said, Ms. Vertin is strong enough to be the Timekeeper.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: However, you will receive punishments for the damage to public property. I suggest you heed it as a warning.
Constantine waves to the crowd. The rest of them are about to leave.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: We should say our goodbye. Please rest well.
She suddenly notices the white dove on the tree and stops.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Hmm, seems like the dove of the white marble house is paying you a visit.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: What do you mean?

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Heh heh ... Nothing peculiar.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: It just means you have come to their notice.
TO BE CONTINUED…
